decisions.question: Which deployed estate do kickoff issues 1354, 1355, 1361 and 1363 target: the estate whose events are emitted through hand-written log1, log2 and log3 and whose markets are deployed by a factory with hooks and role providers?
decisions.decision_maker_role: target maintainer for the Wildcat protocol
decisions.evidence_summary: wildcat-v2-ethereum-mainnet is the only estate in the wildcat-finance organisation that carries both features: src/libraries/MarketEvents.sol emits every market event through assembly log1, log2 and log3, and HooksFactory 0xdd7dd3b5076cf89440d05585ff56d246386207be deploys markets from stored init code with hooks templates and role providers. The Plasma estate is the same source line on chain 9745. V1 emits through assembly too but has no hooks factory.

decisions.question: Which venues and generations fill the five ordered slots kickoff issue 1359 inherited from its filing: the first venue's two generations, the second venue, the venue with three generations, then the two remaining venues?
decisions.decision_maker_role: target maintainer for the Skills repository kickoff programme
decisions.evidence_summary: The filing names no venue. The reuse issues 1139 to 1144 and 1148 name seven venues. Two of them carry three generations in this inventory (Wildcat: V1, V2, V2.5; Centrifuge: Tinlake, v2, v3) and four carry two (Aave, Compound, Euler, Maple), so the ordinal description does not resolve on its own. Surveyor records the inventory and does not assign venues to slots.

options.note: example shape only: Wildcat as the venue with three generations and four of the other six venues in the remaining slots; the maintainer writes the exact ordered list
the maintainer replaces the ordinal description with an explicit ordered list of target ids from this registry
leave issue 1359 blocked on this decision and close 1482 on the inventory alone
